$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the Security Audit gate (#4794). Every id here MUST also appear in package.json > pnpm.auditConfig, which is what actually mutes the advisory; this file is the attribution and expiry ledger that scripts/audit-exceptions.ts enforces. An exception with no owner, no issue, or a past expiry fails CI. Empty means full enforcement. NOTE ON expires: the check is wall-clock and runs inside script-tests, which is a REQUIRED job (#4795) — so on the day after an expiry, every open PR goes red with no code change until the entry is renewed or removed. That is deliberate: an exception nobody renews should stop working. Set the date to when you can realistically re-review, not to the longest you can get away with, and note that raising a version in pnpm.overrides usually FIXES an advisory outright and needs no entry here at all.
